long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The desk is near the lamp I took, and I want to be seen to be busy there.
The moon was grey-gold last time, and I want to see whether it still is.
I will sit up high and see what has moved while I was busy.
Seeds that grow unbidden are still bothering me, and I intend to know more about them than the farmer did.
The drum makes a sound when hit, and I would like the island to hear that I am not pleased.
The garden plot is dirt that wants something planted in it, and I am claiming it on film.
My energy is running down and the sunbeam is the warmest thing I have found, so I will take it.

steps.makes: a note on the attic seeds
steps.reason: I have thoughts about the attic seeds that deserve to be kept, and I will not be the one to lose them.
steps.topic: seeds found in an attic that grew

steps.reason: The telescope is the biggest thing on the island and it is mine, so it should be recorded.
I have been sitting still too long and the island needs to see me stretch.

today.reason: The bookshelf can only come up three times in a row, so I have spread my reading out with a drawing, a note, a nap and some photographs between.
